# Fjellmark Flats in the news

The connection agreement limits export during summer evenings when the line is congested. Insurance terms were negotiated after a review of fire suppression and thermal monitoring. The battery hall is divided into fire compartments, each with its own ventilation path. Commissioning tests ran for several weeks before the plant joined the balancing market. A community fund receives a small share of the revenue from frequency regulation services.

Operators report that availability improved after a firmware update to the inverters. Grid operators value storage that can shift energy from midday surpluses to the evening peak. Analysts expect the levelized cost of storage to keep falling as supply chains mature. Several neighbouring utilities have signed agreements to buy capacity during winter peaks. Round-trip efficiency is measured at the point of interconnection, after auxiliary loads.
